### Weighted neighbor sum { #matrix-weighted_aggregation }

Each node sums its neighbors' values multiplied by edge weights. The summary fixes the comparison to `tiga.prepared_auto` versus `torch.sparse.mm` with hot data caches, retaining every registered topology and feature width rather than selecting the largest speedup.

All rows use 131,072 nodes and FP32 values. F is the number of values per node; i32/i64 describe integer indices, not value precision. Lower latency is better; speedup is peer time / Tiga time, so below 1 is slower.

| Topology | Neighbors | Index | F | Tiga (ms) | Torch sparse (ms) | Speedup |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| regular | local | i64 | 1 | 0.020 | 0.047 | 2.31× |
| regular | local | i64 | 16 | 0.025 | 0.232 | 9.19× |
| regular | local | i64 | 64 | 0.100 | 0.275 | 2.76× |
| irregular | random | i32 | 16 | 0.057 | 0.263 | 4.63× |
| irregular | random | i32 | 64 | 0.206 | 0.400 | 1.94× |
| powerlaw | local | i32 | 1 | 0.020 | 0.041 | 2.00× |
| powerlaw | local | i64 | 1 | 0.023 | 0.038 | 1.65× |
| powerlaw | random | i32 | 1 | 0.054 | 0.070 | 1.30× |
| powerlaw | random | i64 | 1 | 0.054 | 0.071 | 1.32× |
| lognormal | random | i32 | 1 | 0.054 | 0.071 | 1.31× |
| exponential | random | i32 | 1 | 0.055 | 0.071 | 1.29× |

Regular graphs have equal neighbor counts; the other distributions test uneven work. Local/random refer to source-index locality, not network communication.

`prepared_auto` excludes binding/preparation, initial compilation and graph construction. Hot reuses data; cold perturbs the data cache before timing, **not first-time JIT compilation**. These historical paths do not establish end-to-end performance of today's ordinary Torch calls.

All providers and hot/cold results remain below. Confidence intervals express sampling uncertainty; passing a performance check is not a correctness or release certification.
